description.zh: 在受限沙箱中执行 Python 代码。工作目录是当前项目目录，可读写其中文件；默认禁网。用于数据处理、用 matplotlib 画图、读写/转换文件、生成产物等。返回 returncode 与 stdout/stderr 以及新增的产物文件名。
description.en: Run Python code in a restricted sandbox. The working directory is the current project folder (read/write allowed there); network is blocked by default. Use it for data processing, matplotlib charts, file conversion, generating artifacts. Returns returncode, stdout/stderr and any new artifact filenames.

code.description: 要执行的完整、可独立运行的 Python 源代码
complete, self-contained Python source to run
